statement: Let γ ∈ U minimize P, and let X be its controlled diffusion. Then γ(0) = 0 and γ is smooth on [0, 1), with derivatives at zero understood from the right. Moreover, γ(t) = E[Φγ,xxx(t, Xt)2] 2E[Φγ,xx(t, Xt)3] , 0 ≤ t < 1. (6.8) Consequently µγ(dt) = γ′(t) dt on [0, 1), where γ′ is smooth and nonnegative. In fact, for 0 < t < 1, 2γ′ (t)E[Φγ,xx(t, Xt)3 ] ≥ γ(t)2 1000 E[Φγ,xx(t, Xt)4 ] > 0. (6.9) In particular γ′(t) > 0 on (0, 1).
